tasks.title: Expose and integrate two logical V200 devices
tasks.objective: Use all four physical GPUs as two correctly presented logical devices without flattening the directed inter-pair topology. Read planning/v200-bootstrap/tasks/V200-11.md and planning/v200-bootstrap/contracts/EXECUTION_CHARTER.md.

argv:
import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
b=json.loads((root/'evidence/B06/multipair-runs/multipair-20261017T150959Z-75b105fcd3/consumer/bundle.json').read_text())
assert b['status']=='PASS' and b['qualification']=='PASS_TWO_LOGICAL_V200_RESIDENT_CORRECTNESS'
assert b['copy_probe']['status']=='PASS'
assert len(b['selected_gpu_uuids'])==4 and len(set(b['selected_gpu_uuids']))==4
for c in b['controls']:
 assert c['application_status']=='PASS' and c['response']['exact_match']
 assert c['server_process']['exit_code']==0
 assert c['cleanup']['no_live_group_members']
 assert c['layer_offload_evidence']['full_gpu_offload']
 assert c['device_count_evidence']['status']=='PASS'
s=b['v200_summary']
assert s['visible_cuda_devices']==[2] and s['cleanup_accounting_zero']
assert s['all_model_layers_offloaded'] and s['input_embedding_on_cuda0']
assert len(s['four_owner_peak_bytes'])==4 and min(s['four_owner_peak_bytes'].values())>0
r=json.loads((root/'evidence/B06/qualification-r5.controller-result.json').read_text())
assert r['ok'] and r['returncode']==0 and r['evidence_id']=='bdf88682-63b9-4788-8943-b411c03ee1f1'
h=json.loads((root/'evidence/B06/qualification-r5.host-release.json').read_text())
assert h['state']=='released' and h['resources']==[]
print('B06 two logical devices, resident payload, correctness, cleanup and release accepted')
